text:
Maya R: heads-up — our quickstart onboarding is getting churn requests from support. can we cut a "lite" path that gets users from zero->deployed in three tiny steps? auth (env var), run a sample request, first deploy. keep deep explainer content in an "Extended" section.

Leo P: love that. lean path should use SDK as primary, tiny code block, then a one-click deploy button for the sample app. leave a small curl example under advanced.

Aria S: agreed. also note: some customers on SDK7 keep hitting the deprecated env var name. we should add a short migration blurb: `LEGACY_API_KEY` -> `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. one-liner to export for bash: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=\"<YOUR_KEY>\"`.

Maya R: add a compact troubleshooting snippet too: common 401 causes are bad key and clock skew. link to token FAQ: https://redwood.example/docs/token-faq.

Leo P: i'm drafting the sample app as a tiny serverless function. deployment workflow for Git-based provider will be a single "Deploy" button + small workflow. draft workflow: ```yaml
name: deploy-hello
on: push
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '18'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build && npm run start
      - name: Set REDWOOD_KEY
        run: echo "REDWOOD_API_KEY=${{ secrets.REDWOOD_KEY }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
```

Aria S: for examples, switch `client.generate()` to `responses.create()` in all quickstart snippets. also make sure code shows streaming only in the advanced section.

QA Sam: i'll sanity test the serverless flow once preview deploy is live. please keep the sample app under 30 lines so CI builds fast.

docs-bot: created PR #4621 - docs/quickstart/compact-path. includes SDK-focused snippets, serverless sample, and migration callout. CI running.

Maya R: can preview deploys include the deploy button demo so product can click through?

preview-bot: preview available at https://staging-docs.redwood.example/compact-quickstart-demo — preview expires in 6 days.

Leo P: note for the README: remove any literal example keys like `abc123`. replace with `<YOUR_KEY>` placeholder and a tiny note about scopes required (generation + embeddings).

Aria S: will patch the README. also adding a short note about request quotas on free tier.

QA Sam: timeline? would like this merged before next sprint planning.

Maya R: target EOW. @Leo P please request final review when PR has CI green and preview is up.

Leo P: will do. thanks all. :raised_hands:
